newsitem.title: USA: RGI Holdings gains majority stake in Legend.
newsitem.headline: RGI Holdings gains majority stake in Legend.

text.p: RGI Holdings Inc, an affiliate of RGI U.S. Holdings Inc, became the majority holder of Legend Properties at the end of December when it merged with Banyan Mortgage Investment Fund, the chief financial officer of Legend said Wednesday.

As part of the merger, RGI received 4,386,986 shares of Seattle-based Legend when the deal closed December 31, giving it a 79 percent stake in the real estate company, said Legend chief financial officer Ray Whitty in a telephone interview Wednesday.
RGI had purchased 270,664 of Legend's shares December 3-5, Whitty said.

RGI currently owns just under 5.0 million shares of Legend, which holds development properties in Monterey, California, Virginia, Maryland and Vero Beach, Florida, as well as a regional mall near Seattle, Washington, Whitty said.
Legend shares fell 1/4 to seven Wednesday.
